items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Count Basie was number one, 30,000; Jimmy Lunsford, 27,000... and Ernie Fields, 16,000.

ctx.x: Count Basie was number one, 30,000; Jimmy Lunsford, 27,000, Duke Ellington three, 21,000; Lionel Hampton, four,
20,000; Cab Calloway, five, 19,000; Erskine Hawkins, six, 18,000; Louis Armstrong, 17,000 and Ernie Fields, 16,000.
